data.notes: February 2026 has few flagship Ischgl mega-concerts; the confirmed music calendar is mostly family concerts, carnival brass-band events, and nearby Paznaun mountain-night shows.

events.title: Children's Interactive Concerts in Galtür: Heavysaurus
events.summary: The official Galtür event page lists Heavysaurus for 11 February 2026 at 15:00 as part of the 'Erlebe den Berg' children's interactive concert series. Admission is listed as free.

events.title: Medrig Night Fever: Zunder
events.summary: Medrig Night Fever pairs night skiing and tobogganing with a live concert on the Medrig Alm stage and a laser show. The official See page lists Zunder for Wednesday, 11 February 2026.

events.title: Kinderfasching in Ischgl
events.venueName: Kulturzentrum St. Nikolaus / Silvretta Therme route
events.summary: Ischgl's official event page confirms the children's carnival on 15 February 2026 at 14:00. The programme includes a parade with the youth brass orchestra of Musikkapelle Ischgl and a Captain Steampunk children's participatory concert.

events.title: Carnival in Galtür
events.summary: The official Paznaun-Ischgl event page lists Galtür Carnival for 15 February 2026 at 15:00. The costume parade from Galtür primary school to the sports and cultural centre is accompanied by the Galtür music band.

events.title: Children's Interactive Concerts in Galtür: HerrH
events.summary: The official Galtür event page lists HerrH for 18 February 2026 at 15:00 as part of the 'Erlebe den Berg' children's interactive concert series. The source describes the series as music, dancing, and current children's hits in Silvapark Galtür.

events.title: Medrig Night Fever: Loisach Marci
events.summary: Medrig Night Fever's official programme lists Loisach Marci, described as alphorn techno, for Wednesday, 18 February 2026. The event includes a live concert on the Medrig Alm stage plus a laser show.

events.title: Medrig Night Fever: Zwirn
events.summary: The official See page lists Zwirn for Medrig Night Fever on Wednesday, 25 February 2026. The programme confirms a live concert slot on the Medrig Alm stage from about 20:30 to 22:00, followed by a laser show.
